title: Scheduled Water Interruption Notice
content: Please be advised that there will be a scheduled water interruption this coming Saturday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM due to maintenance work by the local water district. Residents are advised to store enough water for the day. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Barangay ID Distribution Schedule
content: Residents of Purok 1, 2, and 3 may claim their Barangay IDs at the Barangay Hall from Monday to Thursday next week. Please bring one valid government ID for verification. Distribution hours: 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

title: Reminder: Proper Waste Segregation
content: All residents are reminded to follow the proper waste segregation schedule: Biodegradable (Monday, Wednesday, Friday), Non-Biodegradable (Tuesday, Thursday), and Recyclables (Saturday). Let us keep our barangay clean and green. Violators may face penalties as per Barangay Ordinance No. 2025-003.
